title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Unnati Hooda, Arjun-Hariharan Begin China Masters Campaign
indian_angle: Indian shuttlers Unnati Hooda and the men's doubles pair of MR Arjun and Hariharan Amsakarun started their challenge at the China Masters 2026.
summary: Unnati Hooda in women's singles and the men's doubles duo MR Arjun and Hariharan Amsakarun were the only Indian players competing on Day 1 of the China Masters 2026 in Shenzhen.

title: Lakshya Sen Leads Indian Charge at China Masters
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen is leading the country's challenge at the China Masters, with a focus also on promising young women's singles players.
summary: Lakshya Sen is set to spearhead the Indian contingent at the China Masters, a Super 750 tournament, where a young trio of women's singles players will also be closely watched.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team championship, which is vital for identifying and nurturing talent across Indian states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Trials
indian_angle: This notification impacts the selection process for India's contingent at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships, highlighting adjustments in the women's doubles category.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a change in a women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is preparing India's top U17 and U15 junior players for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships, a crucial step in their international development.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing young talent.
